scope.target: MiiIcon GameUber draws for the Kestron mii1.ltd input
evidence_policy: Only literal decompiled-source, ELF-byte, and selected-shader-read facts are recorded as exact.
Static initializer bytes are initialization evidence, not Kestron draw values.
Generic formulas are producer closure, not values, until their live inputs are captured.
No conventional matrix, offset, camera, or renderer default is inferred.
reference.png was not inspected and supplies no evidence to this ledger.
mii1.ltd identifies the requested Mii input but does not contain the live renderer state serialized into either buffer.

shape_transform_producer.compose_formula: Scale the three record basis columns by record +0x60/+0x64/+0x68, retain record translations +0x3c/+0x4c/+0x5c, then left-compose the resulting affine 3x4 with the supplied parent affine 3x4.

shape_transform_producer.target_value_rule: The live record and live parent chain at each selected draw are not captured, so descriptor 0 remains value-unresolved for every selected program that reads it.

shape_user_float4_producer.destination_formula: Shape descriptor 14 base +0x80 plus user index * 0x10; copy exactly 16 bytes for each ModelNW shape record and update the corresponding dirty mask.

mii_indices_0_through_4.dirty_rule: Only indices whose bits are set in the input dirty byte are serialized; unchanged GPU words may persist.

shape_user_float4_producer.target_value_rule: The Kestron live MiiShapeUserUniformState fields and dirty history are not captured, so no formula result is committed as a target word.
